name: GridPulse
description: A bordered cell grid where individual cells softly flash with an accent color on deterministic, per-cell offsets set through CSS custom properties, under a radial vignette.
a11yNotes: The grid layer is aria-hidden and pointer-events: none; children keep their semantics. Per-cell delays come from a seeded rand(n) via --mf-gp-delay, so SSR output is stable. Under prefers-reduced-motion the pulses are disabled and only the static grid lines remain.

propsApi.name: pulseColor
propsApi.description: Fill color of a pulsing cell.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Foreground content centered above the grid.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
